title: MellyCore Loop State
description: Contract for a per-loop state file under shared_context/loops/states/. State is the loop's memory OUTSIDE any model conversation: a new session must be able to reconstruct where the loop stands by reading this file alone. Enforced in plain Python by scripts/loop_ops/validators.py, not by a JSON Schema library.

loop_id.description: Must match a loop id in LOOP_REGISTRY.json.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last state write.

last_progress_marker.description: An opaque marker describing what the loop last achieved. If it does not change between runs, the loop is making no progress and the guard says so.

last_error_signature.description: Normalized error identity, not the raw message. Used to detect the same failure recurring.

open_escalation.description: Set when the loop is waiting on a human. Non-null means the loop must not proceed.

human_approval.description: Records real operator approval. This is deliberately explicit: readiness is never inferred from a file merely existing.

run_history.description: Pointers to run ledgers. Presence of real entries is what 'exercised' means in the audit.

forbidden_content.description: Not a JSON Schema keyword. A binding rule, enforced by scripts/loop_ops/redaction.py and the redact-check command.
rules: No secrets, API keys, provider tokens, session cookies, or account identifiers.
State must remain safe to commit and safe to read aloud in a review.
